text:
elaine: publish blocked for staging-eu image. deploy-bot refused canary promote due to provenance check fail — missing KMS annotation on manifest. any infra/pm input? :thinking:

deploy-bot: publish-blocked: provenance_verify FAILED: missing annotation `kms_key_id` on manifest for image `redwood/worker:build-20260320`. Suggestion: pin previous digest or rebuild with kms metadata. See logs: `s3://ci-artifacts/2026/03/20/provenance.log` :warning:

sam_g: if we rebuild with same buildid, downstream hashes will change. not ideal. pin to previous digest sounds safer for the window.

ryan: agree. do NOT republish same buildid. plan: update canary to digest `sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f` (previous successful), monitor CPU & error-rate for 15m, then promote. we'll create a short PR to change k8s image ref.

karen_rm: change window 13:00-15:00 UTC today. we should update release notes and mention this is a temporary pin due to missing provenance metadata; follow-up action to republish with proper KMS annotation.

sam_g: I'll open the PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/services/pull/482 (draft). will include `kubectl` command for ops: `kubectl -n canary set image deploy/worker worker=redwood/worker@sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f` and rollback snippet.

elaine: oncall @ryan can you +1 when you can run the pin? I'll be standing by to cut release note edit.

ryan: +1. prepping the rollout. plan: apply canary patch, run smoke tests, check trace sampling for 10m.

build-bot: provenance log extract:
```
ERROR: manifest annotations missing: kms_key_id
context: publish-job-482
```

deploy-bot: action taken: blocked promote -> canary remains at previous digest. Manual pin requested by @sam_g. Use `deploy-bot promote` once PR merged and tags verified. :white_check_mark:

karen_rm: I'll draft the release note: "Hotfix: pin worker image to previous digest due to missing KMS annotation on published manifest; follow-up republish planned." will push to release-notes.md after pin.

elaine: thanks everyone. postmortem follow-up: owner=infra-team, ticket=INF-1284. we'll schedule a reproducible test for provenance metadata in CI. :memo:

sam_g: PR merged and applied at 13:07 UTC. monitoring.

ryan: canary looks stable at +12m. no increased errors. proceeding to promote in 5m unless objections.

karen_rm: noted in release notes and internal changelog. :eyes:

elaine: closing thread once fully promoted. thanks :pray:
